# Founders Doc

> Founders Doc is a legal practice for founders and start-ups, founded in Singapore in 2021, advising early-stage companies around the world. FD AI is its online drafting tool: answer a few questions and FD AI drafts a legal document from Founders Doc's own lawyer-written masters, ready as a Word document in minutes. A practising lawyer is one click away. Anyone can start free.

## FD AI — draft a document

- [Draft a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)](https://foundersdoc.com/draft?type=nondisclosureagreement): mutual or one-way NDA for founders
- [All documents FD AI drafts](https://foundersdoc.com/draft): term sheets, employment and contractor agreements, shareholders', share purchase and share subscription agreements, investment, loan, convertible loan, services, IP assignment and joint venture agreements
- [Pricing](https://foundersdoc.com/pricing): start free with 3 documents over 14 days (no card), then S$8.80 a document or a membership from S$18.80 a month (SGD)
- [NDA templates](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda): draft a Non-Disclosure Agreement free with FD AI, with pages for Singapore (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/singapore), the UK (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/uk) and the US (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/us)

## Talk to a lawyer

- [FD Consult](https://foundersdoc.com/fd-consult): a fixed-price call with a practising lawyer
- [Contact](https://foundersdoc.com/contact)
